title: Start with the thing people can use.
summary: A useful explanation gives someone a next step.
cover_alt: An indigo textile study accompanying a field note
body:
A helpful explanation should leave someone able to do something: ask a clearer question, compare two options, or understand why a process works.

One way to get there is to start with an everyday problem. Show the first attempt, make one meaningful change, and explain the result.

Examples do more than make a lesson interesting. They let people see where an idea applies and decide whether it helps them.
label: FIELD NOTE · LEARNING
